newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH HARVARD SAYS SELLS MND SHARES.
newsitem.headline: CZECH HARVARD SAYS SELLS MND SHARES.

text.p: Czech investment Group Harvard Capital and Consulting on Thursday said it had sold 108,000 shares of oil and gas explorer Moravske Naftove Doly (MND), previously held by its mutual funds.
Harvard did not release any more information on the sale, but said in a statement that "the sale was 1.8 times greater than its original investment" in MND.

"The whole transaction leads to the raising of the net asset value of the funds by 10-11 percent. We are trying to maximise the profit at our funds," Harvard Vice-president Boris Vostry said in the statement.
"Harvard is preparing to buy up units in its mutual funds...for the price which is equal to their net assset value," he added.
The statement did not say whether Harvard still held any MND shares.
At the end of 1995, Stratton Investments Ltd., wholly-owned by U.S.-born investor Michael Dingman, acquired a 22 percent stake in MND in concert with Harvard.
